resolutionSummary: Added engine-neutral Game.Outcomes.Runtime and semantic Outcomes API contracts so exactly one authoritative gameplay terminal result is committed only by configured authored policy. Ordinary combat/party defeat and technical shutdown remain nonterminal unless explicitly mapped; duplicate requests are idempotent, competing/late requests cannot replace the winner, resolution emits exactly once, and snapshots restore without replay while remaining available to replication/downstream orchestration. Exact-SHA CI also exposed invalid GUID metadata on relocated Outcomes tests; the original Unity GUIDs were restored and revalidated without weakening acceptance.
